content: For admin CRUD forms with many fields (33 admin endpoints worth), react-hook-form remains the standard 2025-2026 choice over hand-rolled useState forms or React 19's useActionState (which is oriented around server actions/Next.js, not a good fit for this SPA+REST architecture). react-hook-form uses uncontrolled inputs for minimal re-renders and integrates cleanly with existing React 19.
